Name: (CP)(FS)Clothes for Danger Weather
Author: batbadbat97
Description:
[size=3][color=#f1f1f1]This mod adds[/color][color=#f1f1f1] retextured clothing(non-replacement) from PDW, and new raincoats. Available in the shops alongside the PDW gears and provide the same buffs under those weather conditions.[/color](Retexturing with the base of their pixel arts with their permissions)[/size][color=#f1f1f1][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1]


[size=4]1.1 Update:[/size]
[size=4]Fashion Sense integration for all clothing items;[/size]
[size=4]Color customization for every piece (via Hand Mirror);[/size]
[size=4]Auto-outfit changes in dangerous weather;[/size]
[size=4]Linked appearance and protective gear.[/size]


[size=3]Accessories: Kittymuffs, Earmuffs, Cute mask, Melon mask.
Hats: Kitty raincoat hood, raincoat hood
Shirts: Kitty raincoat, raincoat

[/size]



[b][size=5]Example of Using Fashion Sense Outfit[/size][/b]
[size=4]1. Purchase a raincoat set [/size]
[size=4]2. Equip it to get the buffs[/size]
[size=4]3. Wear the [u]Linked[/u] version of the gear via [b]Hand Mirror[/b][/size]
[size=4]4. [u]Save the Outfit[/u] and paste over one of the respective names here: 
[/size]
[size=4]   Dangerous Rain[/size]
[size=4]   Dangerous Cold[/size]
[size=4]   Dangerous Air
[/size]
[size=4](Or name it anything you like and copy the name to the config file.)[/size]
[size=4]5. Now the full set should appear automatically when the bad weather hits, equip the protective gear in your hat slot and head bravely outside, with style!
[/size]
[size=3]

If you don’t use FS outfit mod, you’d still wear multiple accessories for them to appear when you equipped protective gear, just harder to find since they’re invisible if you haven’t equipped the gear.[/size][/color]
